connector.name: ProxmoxMCP-Plus
connector.registryDescription: Proxmox VE MCP server for VMs, LXCs, snapshots, backups, storage, and cluster operations.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package proxmox-mcp-plus. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rekklesna account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROXMOX_MCP_CONFIG
env.description: Optional path to a JSON config file. If set, file config is used before environment variable fallback.

env.name: PROXMOX_HOST
env.description: Hostname or IP address of the Proxmox VE API endpoint.

env.name: PROXMOX_USER
env.description: Proxmox username with realm, for example root@pam.

env.name: PROXMOX_TOKEN_NAME
env.description: Name of the Proxmox API token.

env.name: PROXMOX_TOKEN_VALUE
env.description: Secret value of the Proxmox API token.

env.name: PROXMOX_VERIFY_SSL
env.description: Set to true to verify TLS certificates, or false for self-signed lab environments.

env.name: PROXMOX_DEV_MODE
env.description: Set to true when using verify_ssl=false in a self-signed lab environment.

env.name: PROXMOX_SERVICE
env.description: Proxmox service type. Defaults to PVE.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Server log verbosity. Defaults to INFO.
